text:
Bob is 75 miles ahead of Tom.  
Bob’s speed = 55 mph.  
Tom’s speed = 70 mph.

The distance between them closes at the **relative speed**, which is Tom’s speed minus Bob’s speed:

\[
\text{Relative speed}=70\text{ mph}-55\text{ mph}=15\text{ mph}
\]

Time required to close a 75‑mile gap at 15 mph:

\[
\text{Time}=\frac{\text{Distance}}{\text{Relative speed}}=\frac{75\text{ miles}}{15\text{ mph}}=5\text{ hours}
\]

**Final answer:**  
Final answer: 5
